chunks: It was narrated that in the narration of Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
One who withholds the Zakat, let him die; if he wishes, [he may die] as a Jew or as a Christian.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for one who withholds Zakat according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the withholding of Zakat to a voluntary choice of death, suggesting that the non-payer effectively chooses a path of disbelief akin to Jews and Christians, who are often cited in Shia exegesis as those who failed to uphold divine dues. This highlights the theological gravity of Zakat not merely as a financial transaction but as a marker of faith and obedience to the Imamate. The phrasing 'if he wills' implies that the individual retains agency in their spiritual fate, choosing to exit the fold of Islam through their neglect of this pillar.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7.  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  said,  “One  who  does  not  pay Zakat throughout his life, will desire to return to this world at  the  time  of  his  death.  One  who  avoids  payment  of  a penny of Zakat and he dies, he has an option i.e. to die as a Jew or as a Christian.”
